/scripts.value:
command deleteEverything
	global gProject, gProjectName
	local tUsersA, tCurrentEmail, tTeacherRecordID, tBlobsToDelete
	local tAuthResultA, tAuthed
	
	switch there is a stack "Appli"
		case "True"
			get cdb_auth("support@canelasoftware.com","Code4$p33d","developer",gProject)
			break
		
		case "False"
			get cdb_auth("support@canelasoftware.com","Code4$p33d","developer",gProjectName)
			break
	end switch
	
	put cdb_authStatus() into tAuthResultA
	if it is false then
		 put false into tAuthed
	 else
		 put tAuthResultA["cloud"] into tAuthed
	 end if
	
	if tAuthed then
		put cdb_read(cdb_userTableName(), "*", "cloud") into tUsersA
		
		repeat for each key xUserRecordID in tUsersA
			put tUsersA[xUserRecordID]["email"] into tCurrentEmail
			if tCurrentEmail is "appliguest@appli.io" then
				next repeat
			end if
			
			put cdb_query("TeacherID", "=", xUserRecordID, "Teachers", "cloud", "recordList") into tTeacherRecordID
			if tTeacherRecordID is empty then
				cdb_deleteUserAccount tCurrentEmail, "", false
				next repeat
			end if
			
			cdb_deleteTable ("Questions" & "_" & xUserRecordID)
			cdb_deleteTable ("Quizzes" & "_" & xUserRecordID)
			cdb_deleteTable ("QuizCollections" & "_" & xUserRecordID)
			cdb_deleteTable ("ImageScanSets" & "_" & xUserRecordID)
			
			put cdb_list("ImageScans" & "_" & xUserRecordID, "cloud", "blobID", "*") into tBlobsToDelete
			if tBlobsToDelete is not empty then
				cdb_deleteBlob tBlobsToDelete, "cloud"
			end if
			put cdb_list("ImageScans" & "_" & xUserRecordID, "local", "blobID", "*") into tBlobsToDelete
			if tBlobsToDelete is not empty then
				cdb_deleteBlob tBlobsToDelete, "local"
			end if
			cdb_deleteTable ("ImageScans" & "_" & xUserRecordID)
			
			cdb_deleteTable ("StudentAnswers" & "_" & xUserRecordID)
			
			cdb_deleteUserAccount tCurrentEmail, "", false
		end repeat
		
		cdb_delete "Teachers", "*", "local"
		cdb_delete "Teachers", "*", "cloud"
		cdb_delete "Classes", "*", "local"
		cdb_delete "Classes", "*", "cloud"
		cdb_delete "Students", "*", "local"
		cdb_delete "Students", "*", "cloud"
		cdb_delete "AssignedQuizzes", "*", "local"
		cdb_delete "AssignedQuizzes", "*", "cloud"
		cdb_delete "Report1", "*", "local"
		cdb_delete "Report1", "*", "cloud"
		cdb_delete "ClassRosters", "*", "local"
		cdb_delete "ClassRosters", "*", "cloud"
		cdb_delete "CurrentResults", "*", "local"
		cdb_delete "CurrentResults", "*", "cloud"
		cdb_delete "LiveQuizParticipants", "*", "local"
		cdb_delete "LiveQuizParticipants", "*", "cloud"
	end if
end deleteEverything
